text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The summer camp of our third year
comes to an
end. But as everyone's
waiting for the bus home...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What's this?! Zephyr isn't here?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's worrying! What could have
happened to
her?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer... Sorry for worrying you.
choice_data_list: Found you! Zephyr, it's time to he...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to confirm something, just
before we
left.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The wind... that ordinarily blows here.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Our time at camp was spent wrapped in
a lively,
fiery gust. I didn't feel the wind
this keenly last
year.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I figured the state of the environment or
the climate this year must have been
different from
before, but they're both
the same.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Meaning the thing that changed was,
without a
doubt, myself. The winds that
blow about me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I owe them to the rivals who stirred my
spirit by
running alongside me this
summer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...I will not lose.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'll become a gale swift enough to
outpace those
gathering winds.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr! Trainer! You're here!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I thought it would be best just to
wait for
you, but then Bakushin O said...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
She's my rival! We've been pushing each
other all this time, so if she needs an
extra push back to the bus, then it's my
duty as class rep to give it to
her!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...And then she dashed off.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You're all... too kind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's get moving! The ultra
high-speed
Bakushin Express is now
DEPARTIIING—for the
bus stop!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, our blazing hot and slightly

livelier-than-usual summer camp
experience
draws to a close.
